newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's Indupa initiated a sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's Indupa initiated a sell.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities said it initiated coverage of Argentine petrochemical firm Indupa with a "sell" recommendation.
-- "We believe Indupa's shares are fully valued at a price of $0.56 per share,", analyst Paula Bujia wrote in a report.

-- "We forecast fiscal year 1999 earnings will reach $21 million compared to fiscal year 1996 losses of $25.9 million. In fiscal year 1997 and fiscal year 1998 we expect sluggish profits of $10.8 million and $13.5 million respectively."

-- "We also estimate revenues will drop at a compound annual growth rate of 13 percent over the next two years due to declining Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) prices and because Indupa will have sold its High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) plant whose production currently represents 26 percent of total sales. In fiscal year 1999, revenues are expected to recover by 13.8 percent versus fiscal year 1998, due to a doubling of PVC capacity to 150,000 tons."
